messages:
Ana: Opened docs PR #482 to add the Dedicated->Private migration guide. CI preview failed with linkcheck + vale + spellcheck. preview URL: https://preview.redwood.ai/preview/482 :eyes:
Ben: can you paste the failing logs?
Ana: pasted below:
```
LinkCheck: 3 broken links
 - /docs/private/migration -> 404
 - https://old.thirdparty.com/sdk -> 410
 - /examples/sdk/python -> 404
Spellcheck: 2 misspellings
 - 'paramater' -> 'parameter'
Vale: 1 error
 - docs/guides/migrate.md: passive voice detected in intro (rule: WRN001)
Preview: fenced code block language mismatch in examples/sdk.md (expected `python`, got ``)
```
Claire: I can handle the legacy urls and swap the external SDK link to a GH mirror. Assign me as reviewer?
Evan: I'll take the vale/style fixes (imperative headings + no passive voice). Quick heads up: our vale config also flags sentence-case headings.
Ana: thanks. also the preview UI shows a missing snippet render for the python example, CI flagged it as markdown fence issue.
Ben: pushed a tiny commit to fix the fence in examples/sdk.md, but linkcheck still trips on old.thirdparty.com.
Claire: GH mirror works for me. I'll replace the external host with https://github.com/thirdparty/sdk-mirror and add a remark about archived source.
Ana: planning to merge during docs merge window at 19:30 PT tonight — ok? :thumbsup:
Evan: if Claire's link fix + my vale commits land before 19:20 PT I can re-run checks and queue the merge.
Ana: @docs-bot can you re-run preview when the new commits arrive?
docs-bot: queued re-run for build 482-preview on new push. ETA ~5m.
Ben: note we need two approvers for docs PRs > 10 files. @claire and @evan are fine. Once green I'll add final label.
Ana: updated PR with GH mirror, fixed typo and added short note about the migration steps. pinging reviewers.
Claire: reviewed, left a tiny nit on link text (use 'SDK mirror' not raw url). Approved after nit fix. :white_check_mark:
Evan: ran vale locally, fixed passive voice in intro and normalized headings. Approved.
Ana: merging in merge window. checklist: update changelog entry, add redirect rule for /docs/private/migration -> /docs/private/migrate (infra ticket #1023).
Ben: opening infra ticket for redirect after merge.
Ana: thanks all — final preview: https://preview.redwood.ai/preview/482/green. Merge complete. :tada:
